text:
참고용 데이터 입니다. 
아래 11번 행부터 
실제 신청하실 정보를 
입력해주세요.

[신청정보 입력 시 유의사항]
※ 하나의 Excel 파일로 동일한 물류센터만 신청 가능합니다.
※ * 표시된 항목은 필수 입력값입니다.
※ B열(*No)을 연속된 동일한 번호로 복수 상품정보 입력시 하나의 신청서로 묶입니다. (동일한 번호더라도 연속되지 않고 떨어져 있다면 다른 신청서로 분리 생성됨) 
※ 동일한 숫자의 No이면, 받는분정보와 추가신청항목을(AB~AF) 다르게 입력하더라도 상위 한개 행의 정보로 신청서가 생성됩니다.
※ 하나의 신청번호 (동일한 No 숫자) 내에서는 동일한 상품통화로 단가를 입력해주세요.
instructions.groupRule: Consecutive rows with the same B No form one application; non-consecutive repeats form separate applications.
instructions.centerSelection: No center column exists in 신청서. Select center in receiving upload service; ensure carrier center prefix matches. Center list here is inferred from carrier labels.
instructions.currencyRule: Header requests one currency for all rows; row9 also requires one currency per application. Enforce one currency per export.
instructions.fixedShippingRule: AW10 allows fixed shipping only for a single product with quantity 1.

defaultMeaning.note: Convenience choices proposed for UI; not evidence of user intent. No recipient, address, customs identifier, order, product or tracking sample values were copied.
defaultMeaning.currency: No default: require source currency or explicit user selection.
defaultMeaning.carrier: No default: require user selection or exact mapped source value.
defaultMeaning.category: No default: require explicit product classification.
defaultMeaning.unitPrice: Use provided numeric source value; user must confirm whether price includes discounts and tax.

exportNotes: Preserve original workbook sheets, lookup tables, row10 headers and formatting.
Rows 2:8 are template examples and not user order data.
Row1001 contains bottom border cells, not an intended input row.
When replacing formula cells with computed values, remove stale calcChain.xml and its relationship and content type entry.
M11:M1000 is a shared-formula range. Do not leave orphan shared formula followers after replacing master. Clear formula cells in all unused input rows or preserve shared master correctly.
For pickup label 미신청, blank lookup code B2 returns numeric 0 in Excel (verified D6 cached value).
Keep category input codes as text, including leading zeros.
Carrier row C82 exists but the current F11:F1000 validation range ends at C81; config includes actual C82 carrier too.

knownTemplateIssues.issue: Existing named range points to #REF!. Preserve unless intentionally repairing.
Example comment says discount and tax entered after upload; actual input comment says unit price includes discount and tax. User must choose intended pricing rule.
